shared_elements: repeated small units arranged in a grid or file
human head/face in profile within the composition
justification: Both surfaces organize content into stacked horizontal registers of repeated units, and both contain profile human faces and small circular rosette-like forms, but these are generic organizational traits. A depicts a dense two-column grid of abstract, block-shaped composite sign-forms with heavy outline and dense internal filling, whereas B depicts a naturalistic narrative scene of a chariot drawn by a horse with a driver above a file of standing robed figures in procession, with modelled bodies and drapery — utterly different subject matter and rendering conventions.
